title: System Requirements
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:15 AM

System Requirements

For each item, the system is to post a separate interest document
item.

Interest is to be calculated on an monthly baseis for months
started where the key date is in the calendar month.

Subitems are to be totaled before they are rounding according to
the rounding rule in the interest conditions and then subjected to
interest calculation.

Summarize documents that belong together

Interest is to be calculated on cleared subitems if they were not
cleared by the key date for the interest calculation

The base date for the interest calculation is to be moved to the day
after the next working day using the factory calendar (grace period
rule)

The due date of the interest document item should be on the day
after the due date of the item, moved to the next working day

Procedure

Include the fields OPUPW, OPUPK, and OPUPZ in the structure
CI_FKKIV.

In the Implementation Guide for Contract Accounts Receivable
and Payable under
Calculation

Business Transactions » Interest
Item Interest Calculation » Define Interest

Calculation Rules © , in the Interval field enter Month, under
Monthly Interest Calculation enter Month Started/Key Date in

Calendar Month, and for Scale Type , enter No Scaled Interest
Rates.

In the interest key set the indicator Summarize Subitems before
Interest Calculation .

If you require further summarization of documents that belong
together, by main/subtransaction for example, you can define a
customer-specific function module for event 2085. This module
can then summarize by fields of the structure
FKK_INT_ITEM_CHOSEN in addition to OPBEL, OPUPW, OPUPK,
and OPUPZ.You can use function module FKK_CONDENSE_2085
as a template.Event 2085 is only processed if the indicator
Summarize Subitems before Interest Calculation is set.Register
your installation-specific function module for event 2085 in the
Implementation Guide for Contract Accounts Receivable and

Payable under |}}Program Enhancements » Define Customer-
Specific Function Modules

In the Implementation Guide for Contract Accounts Receivable

and Payable , under |}*Business Transactions > Interest
Calculation » Item Interest Calculation » Define Interest Key

set the indicator Consider All Subitems for Interest Calculation in
the interest key.

Only for industry component Public Sector Contract Accounts
Receivable and Payable

In the Implementation Guide for Contract Accounts Receivable
and Payable , under |}#Program Enhancements » Define
Customer-Specific Function Modules | , for event 2090 define

function module FACA_SAMPLE_2090 or use this function module
as a template for an installation-specific module that you register

using event 2090 (see documentation of function module).

In the standard, the due date of the interest document item is the
current system date. You can change the due date of the interest
